info.name: Agentic Engineering Platform + URL Shortener
info.description: Run the folders in order (Collection Runner). Each request has tests; IDs are captured automatically. Users: engineer / approver / admin (see variables).

item.name: 00 Setup and identity
item.description: Run first. Confirms the app is up and shows what each user may do.

exec: pm.test("status UP", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.status === "UP").to.be.true; });
pm.test("engineer cannot approve", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.user === "engineer" && j.canApprove === false).to.be.true; });
pm.test("approver can approve", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.canApprove === true && j.canInjectFaults === false).to.be.true; });
pm.test("admin can inject faults", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.canInjectFaults === true).to.be.true; });

item.name: 01 URL shortener
item.description: Create, redirect, analytics, expiry, deactivation, validation.

exec: pm.test("7-char code", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.shortCode.length === 7).to.be.true; });
pm.test("alias used", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.shortCode === pm.collectionVariables.get("alias") && j.customAlias === true).to.be.true; });
pm.test("code", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.code === "ALIAS_ALREADY_EXISTS").to.be.true; });
pm.test("2 clicks, 2 referrers, 1 day", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.totalClicks === 2 && j.referrers.length === 2 && j.dailyClicks.length === 1).to.be.true; });
pm.test("click count", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.clickCount === 2).to.be.true; });
pm.test("has content", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.content.length > 0).to.be.true; });
pm.test("code", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.code === "SHORT_URL_INACTIVE").to.be.true; });
pm.test("active", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.active === true).to.be.true; });

item.name: 1.17 Create link that expires in 5 s

exec: pm.test("code", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.code === "SHORT_URL_EXPIRED").to.be.true; });

item.name: 02 Scenario 1 - Greenfield
item.description: DAG with parallel branches, final human approval, summary, artifacts, lineage.

exec: pm.test("status is WAITING_FOR_APPROVAL", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.status === "WAITING_FOR_APPROVAL").to.be.true; });
{ const j = pm.response.json(); if (j.pendingApprovals && j.pendingApprovals.length) { pm.collectionVariables.set("approvalId", j.pendingApprovals[0].id); } }
pm.test("RELEASE_EXECUTION pending", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.pendingApprovals[0].type === "RELEASE_EXECUTION" && j.scenario === "GREENFIELD").to.be.true; });

item.name: 2.3 DAG state: gates skipped, branches done

exec: pm.test("conditional gates skipped, final gate waiting", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.find(function (t) { return t.taskKey === "assumption-approval"; }).status === "SKIPPED" && j.find(function (t) { return t.taskKey === "architecture-approval"; }).status === "SKIPPED" && j.find(function (t) { return t.taskKey === "final-approval"; }).status === "WAITING_APPROVAL" && j.find(function (t) { return t.taskKey === "implementation"; }).status === "COMPLETED" && j.find(function (t) { return t.taskKey === "test-planning"; }).status === "COMPLETED").to.be.true; });
pm.test("explains the role", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.code === "ACCESS_DENIED" && j.message.indexOf("APPROVER") >= 0).to.be.true; });
pm.test("status is COMPLETED", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.status === "COMPLETED").to.be.true; });
{ const j = pm.response.json(); if (j.pendingApprovals && j.pendingApprovals.length) { pm.collectionVariables.set("approvalId", j.pendingApprovals[0].id); } }
pm.test("5 sections", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.summary.sections.length === 5).to.be.true; });
pm.test("accepted", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.length >= 10 && j.every(function (a) { return a.status === "ACCEPTED"; })).to.be.true; });
pm.test("has parents", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.some(function (d) { return d.parentDecisionIds.length > 0; })).to.be.true; });
pm.test("1 approved", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.length === 1 && j[0].status === "APPROVED").to.be.true; });
pm.test("many events", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.length > 20).to.be.true; });
pm.test("10 agent executions", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.status === "COMPLETED" && j.agentExecutions === 10).to.be.true; });

item.name: 03 Scenario 2 - Brownfield
item.description: Reflection scan of the real URL module; change impact analysis.

exec: pm.test("status is WAITING_FOR_APPROVAL", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.status === "WAITING_FOR_APPROVAL").to.be.true; });
{ const j = pm.response.json(); if (j.pendingApprovals && j.pendingApprovals.length) { pm.collectionVariables.set("approvalId", j.pendingApprovals[0].id); } }
pm.test("BROWNFIELD", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.scenario === "BROWNFIELD").to.be.true; });

pm.test("impact lists APIs, entities, services, repositories, risks", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.find(function (t) { return t.taskKey === "architecture"; }).output.changeImpact.impactedApis.length > 0 && j.find(function (t) { return t.taskKey === "architecture"; }).output.changeImpact.impactedEntities.length > 0 && j.find(function (t) { return t.taskKey === "architecture"; }).output.changeImpact.impactedServices.length > 0 && j.find(function (t) { return t.taskKey === "architecture"; }).output.changeImpact.impactedRepositories.length > 0 && j.find(function (t) { return t.taskKey === "architecture"; }).output.changeImpact.regressionRisks.length > 0 && j.find(function (t) { return t.taskKey === "architecture"; }).output.changeImpact.backwardCompatible === true).to.be.true; });
pm.test("status is COMPLETED", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.status === "COMPLETED").to.be.true; });
{ const j = pm.response.json(); if (j.pendingApprovals && j.pendingApprovals.length) { pm.collectionVariables.set("approvalId", j.pendingApprovals[0].id); } }

exec: pm.test("questions >= 3 and planning PENDING", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.find(function (t) { return t.taskKey === "requirements"; }).output.clarificationQuestions.length >= 3 && j.find(function (t) { return t.taskKey === "planning"; }).status === "PENDING").to.be.true; });
pm.test("status is WAITING_FOR_APPROVAL", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.status === "WAITING_FOR_APPROVAL").to.be.true; });

pm.test("status is COMPLETED", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.status === "COMPLETED").to.be.true; });
{ const j = pm.response.json(); if (j.pendingApprovals && j.pendingApprovals.length) { pm.collectionVariables.set("approvalId", j.pendingApprovals[0].id); } }

pm.test("READY_WITH_CONDITIONS", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.find(function (t) { return t.taskKey === "release-readiness"; }).output.readiness === "READY_WITH_CONDITIONS").to.be.true; });

item.name: 05 Rejection and rollback
item.description: Reject the final approval: artifacts revert, workflow ROLLED_BACK.

exec: pm.test("status is WAITING_FOR_APPROVAL", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.status === "WAITING_FOR_APPROVAL").to.be.true; });
{ const j = pm.response.json(); if (j.pendingApprovals && j.pendingApprovals.length) { pm.collectionVariables.set("approvalId", j.pendingApprovals[0].id); } }

item.name: 06 Safe-stop on security concern
item.description: Critical finding stops the workflow; only an approver with acknowledgement resumes.

exec: pm.test("status is WAITING_FOR_APPROVAL", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.status === "WAITING_FOR_APPROVAL").to.be.true; });
{ const j = pm.response.json(); if (j.pendingApprovals && j.pendingApprovals.length) { pm.collectionVariables.set("approvalId", j.pendingApprovals[0].id); } }
pm.test("design gate", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.pendingApprovals[0].type === "SECURITY_SENSITIVE_CHANGE").to.be.true; });
pm.test("status is SAFE_STOPPED", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.status === "SAFE_STOPPED").to.be.true; });
{ const j = pm.response.json(); if (j.pendingApprovals && j.pendingApprovals.length) { pm.collectionVariables.set("approvalId", j.pendingApprovals[0].id); } }

pm.test("SECURITY_CONCERN", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.safeStopCategory === "SECURITY_CONCERN" && j.safeStopReason.indexOf("Critical review finding") >= 0).to.be.true; });

item.description: Retry, fallback, exhaustion, validation failure, secret leak. Needs the admin user.

item.name: 09 Dynamic replanning
item.description: Impact analysis, approval for high-impact changes, preserved work, superseded decisions.

exec: pm.test("status is WAITING_FOR_APPROVAL", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.status === "WAITING_FOR_APPROVAL").to.be.true; });
{ const j = pm.response.json(); if (j.pendingApprovals && j.pendingApprovals.length) { pm.collectionVariables.set("approvalId", j.pendingApprovals[0].id); } }

pm.test("applied, work preserved", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.applied === true && j.impactedTasks.indexOf("security-review") >= 0 && j.preservedTasks.indexOf("planning") >= 0 && j.workflowStatus === "CREATED").to.be.true; });
pm.test("status is WAITING_FOR_APPROVAL", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.status === "WAITING_FOR_APPROVAL").to.be.true; });
{ const j = pm.response.json(); if (j.pendingApprovals && j.pendingApprovals.length) { pm.collectionVariables.set("approvalId", j.pendingApprovals[0].id); } }
pm.test("approval required", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.approvalRequired === true && j.applied === false).to.be.true; });
pm.test("re-executed up to the final gate", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.status === "WAITING_FOR_APPROVAL").to.be.true; });
{ const j = pm.response.json(); if (j.pendingApprovals && j.pendingApprovals.length) { pm.collectionVariables.set("approvalId", j.pendingApprovals[0].id); } }

pm.test("revisions", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.find(function (t) { return t.taskKey === "architecture"; }).revision === 2 && j.find(function (t) { return t.taskKey === "planning"; }).revision === 1).to.be.true; });

item.name: 11 Observability
item.description: Metrics and audit, computed from persisted data. Run last.

exec: pm.test("totals, retries, rollbacks, safe-stops, MTTR, definitions", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.totalWorkflows >= 10 && j.retryCount >= 2 && j.rollbackCount >= 1 && j.safeStopCount >= 3 && j.mttrSamples >= 1 && j.definitions.length >= 5).to.be.true; });

item.name: 11.2 Audit trail of the safe-stopped security workflow

exec: pm.test("SAFE_STOPPED and resume audited", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.some(function (e) { return e.eventType === "SAFE_STOPPED"; }) && j.some(function (e) { return e.eventType === "SAFE_STOP_RESUMED"; })).to.be.true; });
